title: Revenue Management & Dynamic Pricing
thesis: Snowflake forecasts demand by source market, optimizes room rates dynamically, and automates revenue decisions — replacing fragmented RMS tools with unified ML-native pricing intelligence

talking_points: Portfolio RevPAR at ฿4,850 — 7% below competitive set average of ฿5,210.
Phuket properties leaving ฿180M in annual revenue on the table due to sub-optimal pricing.
Chinese market bookings up 45% YoY but rate capture only up 12%.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST predicts 23% demand increase for Phuket in the next 30 days — driven by Chinese Golden Week.
Flight capacity from Shanghai and Guangzhou up 35% vs same period last year.
Rate recommendation: increase BAR by ฿800-1,200 for Phuket beachfront properties.
